In reality, the total income of a country is not shared equally, so there is income inequality.
In 1905 the American economist Max Lorenz invented the Lorenz curve to show income inequality.
A Lorenz curve is always on or below the line of perfect equality.
The graph shows the Lorenz curve for one country.
